A boot with real provenance. Handmade in the Camargue region of southern France by La Botte Gardiane, these leather boots are built on decades of expertise and tradition. Originally designed for the gardians, the French cowboys who work the salt marshes and river plains between Nîmes and Montpellier, they remain a true piece of functional design, as practical today as they were in the 1950s.
Cut from thick full-grain leather and constructed entirely by hand, the Botte Camarguaise embodies the rugged refinement that defines the French south. Equal parts workwear and icon, they’ll age beautifully and stand up to a lifetime of wear, in the city or out in the wild.

The Westerman Charcoal Westbury Suit is a beautiful iteration of our tailoring principles, merging a refined seasonal aesthetic with a relaxed, effortless character. Crafted from a soft and lightweight cotton and wool blend, this ensemble features a rich textural finish in a matt charcoal tone, making it a versatile choice for the modern wardrobe.
The Westbury jacket is a single-breasted, two-button style defined by its broad notch lapels. We have kept the construction completely unstructured to afford a fluid feel and a natural drape that settles beautifully on the body. It is a piece that brings a quiet sense of formality to your work wardrobe through the week, yet feels easy enough to style casually over the weekend.
Completing the suit, the Morton trouser is a versatile and single-pleated style finished with a flattering straight leg. The wider shape is designed to create a relaxed silhouette that traverses the smart-casual spectrum with ease, affording more room around the hips while maintaining a clean sartorial line. p-rancourtandcompany-10464279429252.d:
The Bradbury Slipper Rubber Sole offers the same comfort and craftsmanship as our classic Bradbury, with added everyday versatility. Built with True handsewn moccasin construction, it features a supple leather upper in Cognac American Bison and a soft deerskin lining for immediate comfort and an easy, broken-in feel from the first wear.
This version is finished with a durable Meramec rubber outsole, providing lightweight cushioning and reliable traction for life around the house and quick steps outdoors. Designed as an all-season slipper that’s comfortable indoors and practical beyond the doorstep, it brings heritage craftsmanship together with added functionality for daily wear.
Made in Maine, USA. Built for comfort. Crafted to last.

p-rancourtandcompany-10410651156612.d:
The Casual Horsebit Loafer brings a relaxed sensibility to a timeless Ivy classic. With its familiar snaffle detail and easy slip-on profile, it bridges polished style and everyday comfort, pairing naturally with denim, chinos, or summer-weight tailoring.
Crafted in Heritage Brown Double Shot leather, the upper offers a lighter, more organic character that develops depth and variation with wear. Built using true handsewn moccasin construction, this version features an unlined upper and a flexible camp-moc sole that allow the shoe to move naturally with the foot, well suited to casual settings and warm-weather wear while maintaining the character of the classic style.
Easygoing yet distinctive, the Casual Horsebit Loafer reflects Rancourt & Co.’s approach to heritage footwear, combining traditional design with everyday practicality. Each pair is handsewn using true handsewn moccasin construction and crafted in Maine , USA
